title: Failure code registry
description: contracts/failure-codes.json: the canonical list of clientFailure codes (FAILURES.md section 4). Each platform mirrors the codes whose clients include it.

area.description: First segment of the code. 'client' is reserved for client.code.invalid.

operation.description: Second segment of the code: what was being done.

reason.description: Third segment of the code: why it failed.

component.description: Usual label for this code. A call site may pass another component. 'unknown' only for client.code.invalid.

severity.description: Recommended severity for call sites. logFailure itself defaults to error when none is passed.

clients.description: Platforms that emit this code. core codes also run inside react-native.

description.description: One sentence: what failed and what the user sees.
